title: RepositoryEvolutionRelationship
description: Formal canonical data contract for representing verified repository evolution, lineage, topology, and ecosystem relationships in Project ORBIT without mutating repository identity or pull-request scoping.

relationship_id.description: Deterministic, content-derived SHA-256 identifier computed as sha256(source_instance_id | relationship_type | source_repo_id | target_repo_id). Never uses random UUIDs or wall-clock timestamps.

relationship_family.description: Closed taxonomy of four structural relationship families governing directionality, transitivity, and semantic evaluation.

relationship_type.description: Exact evolutionary relationship type established by source evidence.

source_repository.description: Subject repository entity. Must strictly have entity_kind = 'repository'. Never a pull request or code change.

target_repository.description: Object repository entity. Must strictly have entity_kind = 'repository'. Never a pull request or code change.

transitivity_rule.description: Specifies whether this relationship type permits transitive graph traversal under identical provider instance.

verification_status.description: Evidentiary strength status reflecting the degree of verification established by source facts.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the evidence supporting this relationship was captured or observed.

valid_from.description: Optional UTC timestamp indicating when the relationship became historically effective in reality (e.g. ASF graduation date, initial commit import date). Null if unrecorded.

valid_to.description: Optional UTC timestamp indicating when the relationship terminated (e.g. dependency removed). Null if relationship remains active.

provenance_refs.description: Non-empty tuple of cryptographic references to raw source evidence fixtures.

underlying_vcs_id_matched.description: Whether the provider's underlying immutable repository integer ID matched (e.g. GitHub numeric repo id 19853920).

governance_event.description: Formal project governance milestone for PROJECT_LINEAGE (e.g. 'ASF_INCUBATOR_DONATION', 'ASF_TLP_GRADUATION').

fork_point_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA at which fork divergence occurred for REPOSITORY_TOPOLOGY.

semantic_firewall.description: Explicit architectural assertions ensuring that this relationship does not corrupt ORBIT core semantics.

entity_ref_mutation_forbidden.description: Must be true. Asserts that this relationship does not rename or alias EntityRefs.

linkage_auto_upgrade_forbidden.description: Must be true. Asserts that DECLARED_MENTION is never automatically upgraded to EXPLICIT_LINK.

state_transfer_forbidden.description: Must be true. Asserts that PR merge state in target repo does not automatically resolve source Jira issue.

temporal_causality_inference_forbidden.description: Must be true. Asserts that timestamp proximity does not imply causality.

RepositoryEntityRef.description: Canonical EntityRef strictly constrained to entity_kind = 'repository'.

entity_kind.description: Must strictly be 'repository'. Code change or work item kinds are strictly forbidden as evolution endpoints.

fixture_id.description: Relative path or URI to the raw evidence fixture file.

record_locator.description: Path or query locator within the fixture (e.g. 'base.repo.full_name', 'pom.xml:dependencies').

sha256_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the raw evidence payload.

observation_id.description: Optional observation identifier associated with the provenance context.

source_field_path.description: Optional dotted property path within the record locator.
